dogecoin.text: People out here trying to draw triangles on their crypto graphs or talk about Fibonacci this and that to explain/predict what’s about to happen with #dogecoin when it’s a completely irrational and unpredictable investment. STAHP!!! You got lucky! You aren’t Jordan Belfort #HODL

#dogecoin and #SHIB feel like a digital Multi-level Marketing Campaign. When people try and explain where the value in these coins is, it always goes something like: “See, if you buy coins, then tell everyone else to buy coins AFTER you buy, then the value of your coins goes up.”
